decision: Approve the exact user-supplied shared image as the limited-scope visual identity reference for Daniel Soriano on the left and Tomas Rivera on the right, together with its format-derived PNG working master.
rationale: The user explicitly said to use the two men as references and identified the curly-haired man as the museum conservator. Existing manuscript evidence identifies Daniel as the museum conservator and Tomas as the long-haired Cafe Siete baker. Narrow scope and textual overrides prevent incidental image details from rewriting story canon or continuity.
